bio: As the name suggests, this restaurant enjoys a splendid location. Housed in the long-established See-Villa hotel, right by Lake Millstatt, it has a wonderful terrace that extends right to the water's edge! The elegant interior has floor-to-ceiling windows affording unobstructed views of the lake. The menu is rather diverse, featuring international, regional, traditional, seasonal fare – game and freshly caught fish from the lake take centre stage. The bar in the middle of the restaurant is sure to draw the eye....
